name.my: ကြက်သားဆီပြန်

my: ကြက်သားဟင်း
ကြက်သားဆီပြန်

method: Fry the paste in oil, add chicken and water, cook until the water is gone and the oil separates (ဆီပြန်).
notes: Drafted by Claude from general knowledge (2026-11-01); not yet checked against published recipes. Chicken weight is meat and skin without bone. One spoon = one serving spoon of curry with its oil; weigh a few to set servingG.
